parts.text:
Done. Project scaffolded and all 9 tests pass.

```
package.json          nmr bin + test script, engines >=18.6
src/index.js          resolve / resolvePaths / resolveMany
bin/resolve.js        CLI: nmr <request> [--from <path>] [--paths]
test/resolve.test.js  node:test suite + fixtures
```

Key design note: I did **not** hand-roll the algorithm. Node's resolution rules (conditional `exports`, `imports`, self-references, extension/index fallbacks) are subtle and change per version, so `src/index.js:36` delegates to the real thing via `module.createRequire(anchor).resolve()`, anchored at any file *or* directory you pass (`anchorFile` at `src/index.js:12` handles the directory case). Builtins are short-circuited with `module.isBuiltin`.

Try: `node bin/resolve.js left-pad --from test/fixtures/app/index.js`
